checks.prop: O1 the observation invariants are jointly satisfiable
checks.formula: exists obs: N1 & I1 & I2 & I3 & I4

checks.prop: O2 N1 ranges: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
checks.formula: exists obs: others & !(form_err >= 0  and  t_ok >= 0  and  d_min <= D_NONE)
checks.note: excludes: negative errors or durations; distances beyond the sentinel

checks.prop: O2 I1 priority only at the queue point: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
checks.formula: exists obs: others & !(has_prio -> at_queue)
checks.note: excludes: has_prio & !at_queue: a drone away from its queue point believing it may commit (the commit guard also requires at_queue, so this state would be a latent defect, not a commit)

checks.prop: O2 I2 the queue point lies in the approach zone: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
checks.formula: exists obs: others & !(at_queue -> mutex_zone)
checks.note: excludes: at_queue & !mutex_zone: the automaton would follow the formation (or recover) while queued, and the yield/commit edges, which require mutex_zone, could never fire for that drone

checks.prop: O2 I3 a passed gate is out of the approach zone: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
checks.formula: exists obs: others & !(passed -> !mutex_zone)
checks.note: excludes: passed & mutex_zone: approach/yield/commit and pass_done would both describe the same gate

checks.prop: O2 I4 t_ok counts only while the own slot error is ok: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
checks.formula: exists obs: others & !(t_ok > 0 -> form_err < e_ok)
checks.note: excludes: t_ok > 0 with form_err >= e_ok (a stale 'ok for t seconds' counter)

checks.prop: O2 I5 an entry is given up only by a committed drone in the approach zone: excludes observations admitted by the other invariants
checks.formula: exists obs: others & !(entry_abort -> committed & mutex_zone & !passed)
checks.note: excludes: entry_abort for an uncommitted drone (an abort edge that could not fire) or after the gate was passed
